issues.legal_issue: An agreement for sale that recites delivery of possession attracts ad valorem stamp duty when it meets the statutory definition of a conveyance.
A court admitting an insufficiently stamped instrument under Section 34 of the Karnataka Stamp Act must impose the prescribed ten-times penalty and has no discretion to reduce or waive it.

When a party seeks to have an impounded instrument sent to the District Registrar under Section 37(2), the District Registrar must determine the duty and penalty under Section 39, including the appropriate penalty up to the statutory maximum.
